SELECT COALESCE(MAX(queue_no),0)+1 FROM waitlist_entry WHERE shop_id=#{shopId} AND table_type=#{tableType}
SELECT FROM waitlist_entry w LEFT JOIN shop s ON s.id=w.shop_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id=w.user_id WHERE w.user_id=#{userId} AND w.region=#{region} AND w.status IN (1,2) ORDER BY w.id DESC

SELECT FROM waitlist_entry w LEFT JOIN shop s ON s.id=w.shop_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id=w.user_id WHERE w.shop_id=#{shopId} AND w.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND w.region=#{region} AND w.status IN (1,2) ORDER BY w.table_type, w.queue_no
